description: Rewrite the product's STANDING notes to its changelog writer. Both AI passes read them: the classifier that decides which changes are public at all, and the fold that writes the entries. Notes are GUIDANCE, never facts: what to include, what to leave out, what to call things, the house voice. Never write what shipped. That comes from the repository, and a note claiming a release will not put one on the page. This REPLACES the whole note (null or empty clears it, max 2000 characters), so call get_changelog first and send the merged text when you are adding a line. Takes effect on the NEXT draft: an open draft was already folded under the old notes and is deliberately not re-folded, so nobody loses edits. Requires the MANAGER role or above.

notes.description: The complete standing notes, replacing whatever is there. Null or empty clears them
